name: Dana
title: Canopus Rangers
description: A girl born and raised in a druid village deep within the Canopus Mountains. Her overwhelmingly positive personality leads her to interpret any situation optimistically.
introduction:
A girl who was born and raised in a druid village deep within the Canopus Mountains.
Her natural positivity leads her to interpret any situation optimistically.
Among the Canopus Rangers, there is even a saying that when trouble arises, one should go to Dana for comfort.
Through the books that make their way into the guard post, she gained a small glimpse of the outside world and grew curious about both it and city life. When an invitation to the Journey arrived for Dana, she set out for NOA with a heart full of eager anticipation.

Having spent most of her life in the druid village, the complexity of city life is a constant source of surprise and novelty for Dana.
